## Add New Service

1. Once you login into <<prodname>>, you will land on the Services Dashboard. Click on the **CREATE NEW SERVICE** button on the top right corner of the page to create a new service. 

[block:image]
{
  "images": [
    {
      "image": [
        "https://files.readme.io/6c2aea5-Create_a_Service.jpg",
        "create_new_service.png",
        "Screenshot of the Services Dashboard in Webex Connect with a highlighted 'CREATE NEW SERVICE' button located at the top right corner."
      ],
      "align": "center",
      "sizing": "200px",
      "border": true,
      "caption": "Services Dashboard in <<prodname>> showing where to click to create a new service."
    }
  ]
}
[/block]


2. Assign a name to the service. Click on **CREATE** to finish creating the service.

[block:image]
{
  "images": [
    {
      "image": [
        "https://files.readme.io/1f13df5-Create_a_Service1.jpg",
        "create_new_service_dialog.png",
        "Screenshot showing the interface for assigning a name to the new service with the 'CREATE' button highlighted."
      ],
      "align": "center",
      "sizing": "350px",
      "border": true,
      "caption": "Interface for naming and finalizing the creation of a new service by clicking 'CREATE'."
    }
  ]
}
[/block]


3. This takes you to the **Service Dashboard** of the newly created service where you buy numbers, configure apps (i.e. OTT channels), send messages using the Messaging API or create customer interaction flows.

Here are a few tutorials that you can explore next:

| 3   | [How to use the Messaging API?](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/using-the-multi-channel-messaging-api) |
